---
title: "Thesis tables"
output: html_document
params:
  phase1_dir:   "outputs/phase1"
  phase2_dir:   "outputs/phase2"
  node_dir:     "outputs/node_design"
  sens_dir:     "outputs/sensitivity"
  kcm_gtfs_dir:      "data/gtfs/kcm"
  designed_gtfs_dir: "outputs/gtfs"
  cache_dir:    "cache"
  hts_trips_csv: "data/public/psrc_hts/hts_trips.csv"
  hts_households_csv: "data/public/psrc_hts/hts_households.csv"
  daysim_trips_tsv:  "data/public/soundcast/_trip.tsv"
  daysim_parcel_map: "data/public/soundcast/parcel_2023_geography.csv"
  collisions_url: "https://services.arcgis.com/ZOyb2t4B0UYuYNYH/arcgis/rest/services/SDOT_Collisions_All_Years_1/FeatureServer/0/query"
  acs_year:     2023
  out_dir:      "outputs/tables"
---

Builds every data-driven table in the thesis from the pipeline's outputs and
writes each one to `outputs/tables/table_NN_<name>.csv` (numbers formatted as
in the thesis). Tables that are definitions rather than results (1, 3-7, 11,
13, 25) are not generated.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr); library(stringr); library(purrr)
  library(data.table); library(sf); library(lubridate); library(gtfsio)
})
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
dir.create(params$out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

save_table <- function(df, name) {
  write_csv(df, file.path(params$out_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")), na = "")
  knitr::kable(df, caption = name)
}
p2 <- function(f) read_csv(file.path(params$phase2_dir, f), show_col_types = FALSE)
latest_cache <- function(label) {
  f <- list.files(params$cache_dir, sprintf("^%s_[0-9a-f]+\\.rds$", label), full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(f)) stop("No cache file for ", label, " - run Phase1BuildMNL.Rmd first.")
  readRDS(f[which.max(file.info(f)$mtime)])
}
pct  <- function(x, d = 1) sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f%%"), 100 * x)
sgn  <- function(x, d = 1, unit = "%") paste0(sprintf(paste0("%+.", d, "f"), x), unit)

# Layout of the results tables: transit networks down, street scenarios across.
NETWORKS <- c(baseline = "Baseline", triplicate = "Simple 3x", grid = "Grid-Based",
              grid_local = "Grid + Local", node = "Node-Based")
STREETS  <- c(no_pri_no_av = "Current Traffic and Transit Priority",
              no_pri_av    = "Automated Vehicle-Induced Traffic",
              pri_no_av    = "Full Transit Priority Current Traffic",
              pri_av       = "Full Transit Priority and AV-Induced Traffic")
BASE_CFG <- "baseline__no_pri_no_av"
grid_table <- function(values, streets = names(STREETS)) {
  # values: named character vector config_id -> cell text
  out <- tibble(`Transit Network` = unname(NETWORKS))
  for (s in streets) {
    ids <- paste0(names(NETWORKS), "__", s)
    out[[STREETS[[s]]]] <- ifelse(ids %in% names(values), values[ids], "---")
  }
  out
}
summ <- p2("summary_for_thesis.csv")
```

# Table 2. Observed mode share for all intra-Seattle trips (HTS, unweighted)

Intra-Seattle = both trip ends in a census tract that intersects the Seattle
place boundary (the Phase 1 definition). "Used" = the mode enters the
mode-choice model.

```{r table-02}
tracts_sf  <- latest_cache("tracts_sf")
seattle_sf <- latest_cache("seattle_place")
seattle_ids <- tracts_sf$GEOID[lengths(st_intersects(st_transform(tracts_sf, st_crs(seattle_sf)), seattle_sf)) > 0]
geoid11 <- function(x) substr(str_pad(str_replace_all(as.character(x), "[^0-9]", ""), 11, pad = "0"), 1, 11)

hts <- fread(params$hts_trips_csv, select = c("trip_id", "mode_class", "origin_tract20",
                                               "dest_tract20", "trip_weight"))
hts[, `:=`(o = geoid11(origin_tract20), d = geoid11(dest_tract20))]
intra <- hts[o %in% seattle_ids & d %in% seattle_ids]
used_modes <- c("Walk", "Bike", "Micromobility", "Drive SOV", "Drive HOV2", "Drive HOV3+",
                "Ride Hail", "Transit")
order_modes <- c(used_modes, "School Bus", "Other", "Missing Response")
t2 <- intra[, .N, by = mode_class][, share := N / sum(N)][
  , .(Mode = mode_class, Trips = format(N, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
      `Used in Model` = ifelse(mode_class %in% used_modes, "Yes", "No"), Share = pct(share))]
t2 <- t2[match(order_modes, Mode)][!is.na(Mode)]
save_table(t2, "table_02_observed_mode_share")
```

# Table 10. Summary characteristics of all transit networks

Per network (the feeds Phase 2 routes on, existing networks in their no-priority
and priority forms), over a typical Wednesday:

* **Peak hour vehicles** - for every route, the peak number of trips
  simultaneously running between Seattle stops (an interval sweep over trip
  segments inside the city; no layover), summed over routes.
* **Median speed** - route length / median one-way running time, median over routes.
* **Median headway** - per route, the median gap between trip starts in its
  busiest hour (shortest over directions), median over routes.
* **Median route length** - median shape length per route, median over routes.

```{r table-10-helpers}
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x); out <- rep(NA_integer_, length(x)); ok <- !is.na(x) & nzchar(x)
  p <- str_split_fixed(x[ok], ":", 3)
  out[ok] <- as.integer(p[, 1]) * 3600L + as.integer(p[, 2]) * 60L + as.integer(p[, 3])
  out
}
sec_to_time <- function(s) { s <- as.integer(s); sprintf("%d:%02d:%02d", s %/% 3600L, (s %% 3600L) %/% 60L, s %% 60L) }

# A typical Wednesday in the feed, preferring one with no calendar_dates exceptions.
pick_service_date <- function(gtfs, weekday = "wednesday") {
  target <- match(weekday, c("sunday","monday","tuesday","wednesday","thursday","friday","saturday")) - 1L
  if (!is.null(gtfs$calendar) && nrow(gtfs$calendar) > 0) {
    cal <- gtfs$calendar |> mutate(start_date = ymd(start_date), end_date = ymd(end_date))
    cands <- seq.Date(min(cal$start_date), max(cal$end_date), by = "day")
    cands <- cands[(wday(cands) - 1L) == target]
    if (!is.null(gtfs$calendar_dates) && nrow(gtfs$calendar_dates) > 0) {
      ex <- ymd(gtfs$calendar_dates$date)
      n_ex <- vapply(cands, function(d) sum(ex == d), integer(1))
      return(if (any(n_ex == 0L)) cands[which(n_ex == 0L)[1]] else cands[which.min(n_ex)])
    }
    return(cands[1])
  }
  cd <- ymd(gtfs$calendar_dates$date)
  sort(unique(cd[(wday(cd) - 1L) == target]))[1]
}
services_on <- function(gtfs, date) {
  active <- character()
  if (!is.null(gtfs$calendar) && nrow(gtfs$calendar) > 0) {
    cal <- gtfs$calendar |> mutate(start_date = ymd(start_date), end_date = ymd(end_date))
    active <- cal |> filter(start_date <= date, end_date >= date,
                            .data[[tolower(weekdays(date))]] == 1) |> pull(service_id)
  }
  if (!is.null(gtfs$calendar_dates) && nrow(gtfs$calendar_dates) > 0) {
    cd <- gtfs$calendar_dates |> mutate(date = ymd(date)) |> filter(date == !!date)
    active <- setdiff(union(active, cd$service_id[cd$exception_type == 1]),
                      cd$service_id[cd$exception_type == 2])
  }
  unique(active)
}
# Expand frequencies.txt into explicit trips (the designed networks are frequency-based).
expand_frequencies <- function(gtfs) {
  if (is.null(gtfs$frequencies) || nrow(gtfs$frequencies) == 0) return(gtfs)
  fr <- gtfs$frequencies |> mutate(s = time_to_sec(start_time), e = time_to_sec(end_time),
                                   h = as.integer(headway_secs))
  st <- gtfs$stop_times |> mutate(arr = time_to_sec(arrival_time), dep = time_to_sec(departure_time))
  first_dep <- st |> group_by(trip_id) |> summarise(f = min(dep, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  new_tr <- list(); new_st <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(fr))) {
    f <- fr[i, ]; tpl_tr <- gtfs$trips[gtfs$trips$trip_id == f$trip_id, ]
    tpl_st <- st[st$trip_id == f$trip_id, ]; f0 <- first_dep$f[first_dep$trip_id == f$trip_id]
    for (k in seq(f$s, f$e - f$h, by = f$h)) {
      id <- sprintf("%s_F%04d_%06d", f$trip_id, i, k); sh <- k - f0
      new_tr[[length(new_tr) + 1]] <- mutate(tpl_tr, trip_id = id)
      new_st[[length(new_st) + 1]] <- tpl_st |>
        mutate(trip_id = id, arrival_time = sec_to_time(arr + sh), departure_time = sec_to_time(dep + sh)) |>
        select(-arr, -dep)
    }
  }
  kill <- unique(fr$trip_id)
  gtfs$trips <- bind_rows(gtfs$trips[!gtfs$trips$trip_id %in% kill, ], bind_rows(new_tr))
  gtfs$stop_times <- bind_rows(gtfs$stop_times[!gtfs$stop_times$trip_id %in% kill, ], bind_rows(new_st))
  gtfs$frequencies <- NULL
  gtfs
}
peak_headway_sec <- function(starts) {
  starts <- starts[is.finite(starts)]; if (length(starts) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  hr <- floor(starts / 3600); pk <- as.integer(names(which.max(table(hr))))
  x <- sort(starts[hr == pk]); if (length(x) < 2) NA_real_ else as.numeric(median(diff(x)))
}
haversine_m <- function(lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2) {
  la1 <- lat1 * pi / 180; la2 <- lat2 * pi / 180
  a <- sin((la2 - la1) / 2)^2 + cos(la1) * cos(la2) * sin((lon2 - lon1) * pi / 360)^2
  2 * 6371008.8 * asin(pmin(1, sqrt(a)))
}
sweep_peak <- function(starts, ends) {
  ok <- is.finite(starts) & is.finite(ends) & ends > starts
  n <- sum(ok); if (!n) return(0L)
  ev <- data.frame(t = c(starts[ok], ends[ok]), d = c(rep(1L, n), rep(-1L, n)))
  ev <- ev[order(ev$t, ev$d), ]           # an end before a start at the same instant = one vehicle
  as.integer(max(cumsum(ev$d)))
}

# Seattle = King County 2020 tracts whose centroid lies in the Seattle place.
seattle_place <- tigris::places(state = "WA", year = 2020, cb = TRUE) |>
  filter(NAME == "Seattle") |> st_transform(4326)
king <- tigris::tracts(state = "WA", county = "King", year = 2020, cb = TRUE) |> st_transform(4326)
seattle_poly <- king[st_within(st_centroid(king), seattle_place, sparse = FALSE)[, 1], ] |>
  st_union() |> st_make_valid()

route_stats <- function(zip) {
  gtfs <- expand_frequencies(gtfsio::import_gtfs(zip))
  day  <- pick_service_date(gtfs)
  trips <- gtfs$trips |> filter(service_id %in% services_on(gtfs, day))
  stops <- gtfs$stops |> mutate(stop_lat = as.numeric(stop_lat), stop_lon = as.numeric(stop_lon)) |>
    filter(!is.na(stop_lat)) |> st_as_sf(coords = c("stop_lon", "stop_lat"), crs = 4326)
  in_sea <- stops$stop_id[st_within(stops, seattle_poly, sparse = FALSE)[, 1]]
  st <- gtfs$stop_times |> filter(trip_id %in% trips$trip_id) |>
    mutate(arr = time_to_sec(arrival_time), dep = time_to_sec(departure_time),
           stop_sequence = as.integer(stop_sequence), in_sea = stop_id %in% in_sea) |>
    arrange(trip_id, stop_sequence) |>
    group_by(trip_id) |> mutate(block = cumsum(is.na(lag(in_sea)) | lag(in_sea) != in_sea)) |> ungroup()
  # in-Seattle segments of each trip (>= 2 stops) -> peak simultaneous trips per route
  blocks <- st |> filter(in_sea) |> group_by(trip_id, block) |>
    summarise(n = n(), s = first(coalesce(dep, arr)), e = last(coalesce(arr, dep)), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(n >= 2, e > s) |> inner_join(trips |> select(trip_id, route_id), by = "trip_id")
  veh <- blocks |> group_by(route_id) |> summarise(vehicles = sweep_peak(s, e), .groups = "drop")
  meta <- st |> group_by(trip_id) |>
    summarise(start = min(coalesce(dep, arr), na.rm = TRUE), end = max(coalesce(arr, dep), na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    inner_join(trips |> select(trip_id, route_id, any_of("direction_id"), any_of("shape_id")), by = "trip_id")
  if (!"direction_id" %in% names(meta)) meta$direction_id <- 0L
  hw <- meta |> group_by(route_id, direction_id) |> summarise(h = peak_headway_sec(start), .groups = "drop") |>
    group_by(route_id) |> summarise(headway_min = suppressWarnings(min(h[h > 0], na.rm = TRUE)) / 60, .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(headway_min = ifelse(is.finite(headway_min), headway_min, NA_real_))
  run <- meta |> filter(end > start) |> group_by(route_id) |>
    summarise(run_sec = median(end - start), .groups = "drop")
  shp <- gtfs$shapes |> mutate(lat = as.numeric(shape_pt_lat), lon = as.numeric(shape_pt_lon),
                               seq = as.numeric(shape_pt_sequence)) |>
    arrange(shape_id, seq) |> group_by(shape_id) |>
    summarise(m = sum(haversine_m(lag(lon), lag(lat), lon, lat), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  len <- meta |> distinct(route_id, shape_id) |> inner_join(shp, by = "shape_id") |>
    group_by(route_id) |> summarise(miles = median(m) * 0.000621371, .groups = "drop")
  gtfs$routes |> select(route_id) |> inner_join(run, by = "route_id") |>
    left_join(veh, by = "route_id") |> left_join(hw, by = "route_id") |> left_join(len, by = "route_id") |>
    mutate(vehicles = coalesce(vehicles, 0L), speed_mph = miles / (run_sec / 3600))
}
```

```{r table-10}
networks <- list(
  `Baseline`                     = "kcm_transit_april_26.zip",
  `Baseline + Transit Priority`  = "kcm_baseline_tsp_april_26.zip",
  `Simple 3x`                    = "kcm_triplicate_april_26.zip",
  `Simple 3x + Transit Priority` = "kcm_triplicate_tsp_april_26.zip",
  `Grid-Based`   = c("gtfs_grid_express.zip", "gtfs_grid_frequent.zip"),
  `Grid + Local` = c("gtfs_grid_express_gl.zip", "gtfs_grid_standard.zip", "gtfs_grid_locals.zip"),
  `Node-Based`   = c("gtfs_node_bus.zip", "gtfs_node_local.zip"))
t10 <- imap_dfr(networks, function(files, nm) {
  dirs <- ifelse(startsWith(files, "kcm_"), params$kcm_gtfs_dir, params$designed_gtfs_dir)
  r <- map_dfr(file.path(dirs, files), route_stats)
  tibble(`Transit Network` = nm,
         `Peak Hour Vehicles` = format(sum(r$vehicles), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
         `Median Speed (mph)` = round(median(r$speed_mph, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
         `Median Headway (min)` = round(median(r$headway_min, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
         `Median Route Length (mi)` = round(median(r$miles, na.rm = TRUE), 1))
})
save_table(t10, "table_10_network_summary")
```

# Table 12. Trips by whether they cross the city limits (SoundCast)

Seattle = census tracts that intersect the city boundary (as in Phase 1 and 2).

```{r table-12}
con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
parcels <- fread(params$daysim_parcel_map, select = c("ParcelID", "Census2020Tract"))
duckdb::duckdb_register(con, "parcels", parcels[, .(ParcelID, sea = sprintf("%011.0f", as.numeric(Census2020Tract)) %in% seattle_ids)])
DBI::dbExecute(con, sprintf(
  "CREATE TABLE trips AS SELECT opcl, dpcl, mode, trexpfac FROM read_csv_auto('%s', delim='\t')",
  normalizePath(params$daysim_trips_tsv, winslash = "/")))
buckets <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT coalesce(o.sea, false) AS o_sea, coalesce(d.sea, false) AS d_sea, sum(t.trexpfac) AS trips
  FROM trips t LEFT JOIN parcels o ON t.opcl = o.ParcelID LEFT JOIN parcels d ON t.dpcl = d.ParcelID
  GROUP BY 1, 2")
tot <- sum(buckets$trips); cell <- function(o, d) pct(buckets$trips[buckets$o_sea == o & buckets$d_sea == d] / tot)
t12 <- tibble(`% of Trips in PSRC` = c("Starting in Seattle", "Starting outside Seattle"),
              `Ending in Seattle` = c(cell(TRUE, TRUE), cell(FALSE, TRUE)),
              `Ending Outside Seattle` = c(cell(TRUE, FALSE), cell(FALSE, FALSE)))
save_table(t12, "table_12_city_limit_trips")
```

# Table 14. Seattle Vision Zero statistics, 2021-2025 (SDOT Collisions)

These are also the Phase 2 Vision Zero baselines (5-year means: 29.4 fatalities,
222.8 serious injuries).

```{r table-14}
year_sums <- map_dfr(2021:2025, function(y) {
  r <- httr::GET(params$collisions_url, query = list(
    where = sprintf("INCDATE >= DATE '%d-01-01' AND INCDATE < DATE '%d-01-01'", y, y + 1),
    outStatistics = jsonlite::toJSON(list(
      list(statisticType = "sum", onStatisticField = "SERIOUSINJURIES", outStatisticFieldName = "si"),
      list(statisticType = "sum", onStatisticField = "FATALITIES", outStatisticFieldName = "fat")),
      auto_unbox = TRUE),
    f = "json"))
  httr::stop_for_status(r)
  a <- jsonlite::fromJSON(httr::content(r, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))$features$attributes
  tibble(year = y, serious_injuries = a$si, fatalities = a$fat)
})
t14 <- tibble(` ` = c("Serious injuries", "Fatalities"))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(year_sums)))
  t14[[as.character(year_sums$year[i])]] <- c(year_sums$serious_injuries[i], year_sums$fatalities[i])
save_table(t14, "table_14_vision_zero_statistics")
cat(sprintf("5-year means: %.1f fatalities, %.1f serious injuries\n",
            mean(year_sums$fatalities), mean(year_sums$serious_injuries)))
```

# Table 17. Basic trip characteristics by mode (baseline)

Share of trips = the Phase 2 baseline (existing network, current streets) daily
mode share; total trips = SoundCast intra-Seattle trips by mode (weighted);
travel time and trip length = HTS intra-Seattle trips by chosen mode, the
Phase 1 skim for that mode (drive time calibrated; transit = walk + wait +
in-vehicle), weighted by the HTS trip weight.

```{r table-17}
ms <- p2("mode_share_daily_by_config.csv") |> filter(config_id == BASE_CFG)
ds <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT CASE WHEN t.mode = 1 THEN 'walk' WHEN t.mode = 2 THEN 'bike'
              WHEN t.mode IN (3, 4, 5, 9) THEN 'drive' WHEN t.mode IN (6, 7) THEN 'transit' END AS m,
         sum(t.trexpfac) AS trips
  FROM trips t JOIN parcels o ON t.opcl = o.ParcelID JOIN parcels d ON t.dpcl = d.ParcelID
  WHERE o.sea AND d.sea GROUP BY 1")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
tc <- readRDS(file.path(params$phase1_dir, "trips_calibrated.rds"))
w  <- hts[, .(trip_id = as.numeric(trip_id), trip_weight)]
tc <- tc |> inner_join(w, by = "trip_id") |>
  mutate(tt = case_when(mode_norm == "walk" ~ walk_tt_raw, mode_norm == "bike" ~ bike_tt_raw,
                        mode_norm == "drive" ~ drive_tt_cal, mode_norm == "transit" ~ transit_total_raw),
         mi = case_when(mode_norm == "walk" ~ walk_dist_mi, mode_norm == "bike" ~ bike_dist_mi,
                        mode_norm == "drive" ~ drive_dist_mi, mode_norm == "transit" ~ transit_dist_mi)) |>
  filter(is.finite(tt), is.finite(mi), trip_weight > 0)
wmed <- function(x, w) { o <- order(x); x[o][which(cumsum(w[o]) / sum(w) >= 0.5)[1]] }
modes <- c(walk = "Walk", bike = "Bike", drive = "Drive", transit = "Transit")
t17 <- map_dfr(names(modes), function(m) {
  x <- tc |> filter(mode_norm == m)
  tibble(Mode = modes[[m]], `% of Trips` = pct(ms[[paste0("mode_", m, "_daily")]]),
         `Total Trips` = format(round(ds$trips[which(ds$m == m)]), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
         `Average Travel Time (min)` = round(weighted.mean(x$tt, x$trip_weight), 1),
         `Median Travel Time (min)`  = round(wmed(x$tt, x$trip_weight), 1),
         `Average Trip Length (miles)` = round(weighted.mean(x$mi, x$trip_weight), 1))
})
save_table(t17, "table_17_trip_characteristics_by_mode")
```

# Table 18. Comparison to American Community Survey commute shares

PSRC = HTS commute trips (home to work or work to home) by residents of
Seattle tracts, weighted. ACS = table B08301 (means of transportation to work),
summed over Seattle tracts, 5-year estimates; car, truck or van, taxi and
motorcycle count as drive, and work-from-home and "other" are left out. Both
are shares of the four modes.

```{r table-18}
hh <- fread(params$hts_households_csv, select = c("household_id", "home_tract20"))
hh <- unique(hh[, .(household_id, home = geoid11(home_tract20))])
hts_c <- fread(params$hts_trips_csv, select = c("household_id", "mode_class", "trip_weight",
                                                "origin_purpose_cat", "dest_purpose_cat"))
commute <- hts_c[(origin_purpose_cat == "Home" & dest_purpose_cat == "Work") |
                 (origin_purpose_cat == "Work" & dest_purpose_cat == "Home")][
  hh[home %in% seattle_ids], on = "household_id", nomatch = 0]
norm_mode <- function(m) case_when(str_detect(m, "Walk") ~ "walk", str_detect(m, "Bike|Micromob") ~ "bike",
                                   str_detect(m, "Transit") ~ "transit", str_detect(m, "Drive|Hail") ~ "drive")
psrc <- commute[, .(trips = sum(trip_weight)), by = .(m = norm_mode(mode_class))][!is.na(m)]
psrc[, share := trips / sum(trips)]

acs <- tidycensus::get_acs(geography = "tract", state = "WA", county = "King", table = "B08301",
                           year = params$acs_year, survey = "acs5") |>
  filter(GEOID %in% seattle_ids)
acs_v <- list(drive = c("B08301_002", "B08301_016", "B08301_017"), transit = "B08301_010",
              bike = "B08301_018", walk = "B08301_019")
acs_n <- vapply(acs_v, function(v) sum(acs$estimate[acs$variable %in% v]), numeric(1))

t18 <- tibble(Mode = unname(modes[c("walk", "drive", "bike", "transit")])) |>
  mutate(m = names(modes)[match(Mode, modes)],
         `% of PSRC Work Trips` = pct(psrc$share[match(m, psrc$m)], 0),
         `Total Trips` = format(round(psrc$trips[match(m, psrc$m)]), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
         `ACS Mode Share` = pct(acs_n[m] / sum(acs_n), 0)) |>
  select(-m)
save_table(t18, "table_18_acs_comparison")
```

# Table 24. Output metrics for two models at AM peak (sensitivity base point)

```{r table-24}
sm <- read_csv(file.path(params$sens_dir, "sensitivity_metrics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(tag == "base") |> arrange(role)
f <- function(r) sm[sm$role == r, ]
t24 <- tibble(
  Metric = c("Drive mode share", "Transit mode share", "Network-avg speed (mph)",
             "Transit jobs reachable / 30 min", "Drive jobs reachable / 30 min",
             "Projected fatalities / yr"),
  `Baseline Networks` = c(pct(f("baseline")$drive), pct(f("baseline")$transit),
                          sprintf("%.1f", f("baseline")$avg_speed_mph),
                          format(round(f("baseline")$jobs_30min_transit), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
                          format(round(f("baseline")$jobs_30min_drive), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
                          sprintf("%.1f", f("baseline")$fatalities)),
  `Grid + Local and AV-Induced Traffic` = c(pct(f("treatment")$drive), pct(f("treatment")$transit),
                          sprintf("%.1f", f("treatment")$avg_speed_mph),
                          format(round(f("treatment")$jobs_30min_transit), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
                          format(round(f("treatment")$jobs_30min_drive), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
                          sprintf("%.1f (%+.0f%%)", f("treatment")$fatalities,
                                  100 * (f("treatment")$fatalities / f("baseline")$fatalities - 1))))
save_table(t24, "table_24_sensitivity_base_point")
```

# Table 29. Projections by time of day, Grid + Local with AV-induced traffic

```{r table-29}
vz <- p2("vision_zero_by_config_tod.csv") |> filter(config_id == "grid_local__pri_av") |>
  mutate(tod = factor(tod, c("AM", "Midday", "PM", "Evening", "Night"))) |> arrange(tod)
t29 <- vz |> transmute(
  `Time of Day` = recode(as.character(tod), AM = "AM peak", PM = "PM peak"),
  `Speed Change` = sgn(100 * (speed_ratio - 1)),
  `VMT Ratio` = sprintf("%.3f", vmt_ratio),
  `Fatalities (baseline)` = sprintf("%.2f", fatal_baseline_t),
  `Fatalities (projected)` = sprintf("%.2f", fatal_t),
  `Serious Injuries (baseline)` = sprintf("%.1f", si_baseline_t),
  `Serious Injuries (projected)` = sprintf("%.1f", si_t))
save_table(t29, "table_29_vision_zero_by_tod")
```
